name: Popover and modal dialog
plain: Shows overlays on top of everything on the page using the top layer.
meaning: A site can draw modal dialogs and popovers above all other content, including iframes. They are page content, not browser UI, so well made fakes can mimic prompts.

access.revocation: Nothing to revoke (no permission is stored)
access.iframe: Top layer belongs to each document; cannot cover browser UI

limits.headline: Can show a box over everything else on the page
limits.user_action: Nothing for most boxes. It happens when you tap a menu, a help bubble or Open details.
can: Show a menu, tooltip or confirm box on top of the page
Dim and lock the page behind a modal box until you close it
Close the box when you press Esc or tap outside
cannot: Cover things outside its own page, like the address bar or other tabs
Stop you leaving the tab or closing the browser
Show over another app on your phone or computer

story.what_it_is: A page can put a box on top of everything, using built in browser tools.

marketing.name: Popover API
marketing.pitch: Chrome's blog says the Popover API lets developers show floating content above the rest of the page with little code.

story.for_you: Menus, tooltips and 'accept cookies' boxes sit neatly on top of the page, and keyboard and screen readers handle them better than home made versions.
story.for_makers: Makers replace fragile custom code with built in pieces. It means fewer bugs, better accessibility and lighter pages, and it standardizes how consent banners and menus work.

use_cases.example: A product page opens a size chart as a modal that dims the page behind it.
A cookie consent banner is drawn on top of the whole page by the site.
A modal traps keyboard focus so someone using a screen reader cannot tab behind it.
A browser game shows a pause menu on top of the playing field.
A dropdown menu in a web app pops open above the rest of the page.
A photo viewer opens a lightbox over a feed.

technical_bounds: No activation required to show a dialog or popover (activation required for fullscreen only)
Cannot draw outside the viewport or over the address bar and permission bubbles
popover=auto uses light dismiss; popover=manual does not
Support: dialog Chrome 37, Safari 15.4, Firefox 98; popover Chrome 114, Safari 17, Firefox 125

abuse: Fake browser permission dialogs drawn inside the page
